• emitCloseMenu event bubbles up from DropdownMenu
→ NavigationMenu → Header to close panel after nav
NAVIGATION TREE — 4 top-level items | 2 with dropdown sub-links | 2 direct-navigate
• Desktop (lg+): NavigationMenu in .navbar-center | menu-horizontal text-2xl font-medium | <details> v-element-hover 300ms enter delay | click title → parent route
• Mobile (<lg): <details> in .navbar-start toggled by hamburger | NavigationMenu with hover=false border=false | w-100 menu-compact text-lg shadow rounded-box
• Click item: goto({ name, hash }) via router.push() | emitCloseMenu closes mobile dropdown | handleCloseMenu() sets isOpen=false + removes open attr
